newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: SKI JUMPING-FUNAKI EDGES OUT PETERKA IN FOUR-HILL EVENT.
newsitem.headline: SKI JUMPING-FUNAKI EDGES OUT PETERKA IN FOUR-HILL EVENT.

text.p: Japan's Kazuyoshi Funaki won a World Cup ski jumping event -- the third leg of the prestigious four-hill tournament -- on Saturday.
Funaki edged out Slovenian teenager Primoz Peterka who took the lead in the four-hill overall standings. The tournament concludes with an event in Bischofshofen, Austria, on January 6.
Funaki, 21, posted jumps of 116 and 113.5 metres on the hill which hosted the 1976 Olympic Games to earn 254.1 points.
The victory was Funaki's second on this hill and the sixth by a Japanese jumper in the four-hill tournament.
Peterka produced jumps of 118.5 and 111 metres for 253.1 points.
Germany's Dieter Thoma, who won the first of the winter's four-hill jumps in Oberstdorf, broke the hill record with a leap of 120 metres with his first jump.
However, a poor effort of 104.5 in the second round dropped the German back to ninth place and buried his chances of capturing the overall four-hill trophy.
